ns2:group.ns2:description:
当孟京辉把《等待戈多》搬到学校操场的煤堆上演出时，你就知道，他的人生剧本注定不会遵循经典叙事。 从中央戏剧学院那个“爱惹事的学生”，到中国先锋戏剧一面无法绕开的旗帜，孟京辉的前半生与他的戏剧一样，充斥着“不老实”的荷尔蒙与孩童般的探索欲。在这次长谈中，他聊起在排练场大喊“我错了”的快感，谈起押上全部身家赌一部戏时的豪迈，也毫不避讳因“闯祸太多”而被母校“婉拒”的往事...他的个人进化史，几乎等同于一部中国当代戏剧的突围史——那是一位创作者为了对抗沉闷的旧世界，而发动的漫长“远征”。 《罗永浩的十字路口》第二十一期，我们和戏剧导演孟京辉展开了一场坦诚且充满细节的回望。他畅所欲言地分享着往事，让我们得以窥见一位大师的成长路径，听着他是如何从一名可爱的“反叛者”，一步步成长为伟大的“建构者”——他不仅亲手缔造了乌镇和阿那亚的戏剧乌托邦，更在每位观众心里留下一头拒绝被驯服的“犀牛”。
When Meng Jinghui staged Waiting for Godot on a pile of coal in a schoolyard, you knew his life script was never going to follow a conventional arc. From the "troublemaking student" at the Central Academy of Drama to an unavoidable banner of China's avant-garde theatre, Meng's first act in life — much like his plays — was filled with rebellious energy and a childlike urge to explore. In this long conversation, he recalls the strange pleasure of shouting "I was wrong!" in rehearsal rooms, the audacity of betting everything on a single production, and — with zero sugarcoating — the stories behind being politely "rejected" by his alma mater after causing too much trouble. His personal evolution almost mirrors the breakout history of contemporary Chinese theatre itself — a long expedition launched by a creator determined to challenge an old, stagnant world. In Episode 21 of Crossroads with Luo Yonghao, Meng Jinghui looks back with remarkable candor and detail. Through his stories, we witness how a beloved rebel gradually became a builder of theatrical utopias — shaping cultural spaces like Wuzhen Theatre Festival and Aranya Theatre Festival, while leaving a rhinoceros in the heart of every audience member — one that refuses to be tamed.

柏格醫生 dr berg 談：這10種維生素和礦物質，千萬別吃！不是吃了沒效，是危險高，卻允許販賣，因成本低，利潤高。各大廠牌維生素，由大藥廠、大化工產業、垃圾食品產業所有。
1.合成維生素A 堆積在肝和脂肪細胞，導致毒性，尤其使孕期胎兒，容易先天缺陷。干擾維生素D和K2，骨質流失，容易骨折。
2.β-胡蘿蔔素 不是活性維生素A，來自煤焦油和石油，增加癌症風險。
3.合成葉酸(folic acid是合成維生素B9) 不是活性葉酸(folate是活性維生素B9)。全球30~40%人口，有MTHFR基因異常，干擾活性葉酸轉化力，導致合成葉酸堆積血中，增加癌症，降低免疫。
4.合成維生素B12，叫氰鈷胺(cyanocobalamin) 轉為活性B12(甲鈷胺/methylcobalamin)，需穀胱甘肽。吃大量合成B12，耗掉穀胱甘肽(重要抗氧化劑)。
5.碳酸鈣 是常見綜合維生素的主要成分。堆積在動脈和腎，甚至引發心臟病發作。
6.鐵補充劑 高腐蝕，傷身，很難排掉。鐵太多，引發2型糖尿病、肝病、帕金森、阿茲海默。常見鐵補充劑，是硫酸亞鐵(ferrous sulfate)，有害且品質低劣。
7.氧化鎂(magnesium oxide) 廉價，吸收率僅3%，常引發腹瀉。選甘胺酸鎂(magnesium glycinate)最好，吸收率80~85%，不腹瀉，改善睡眠、降低皮質醇、減少肌肉痙攣、增加能量。
8.合成維生素D2(麥角鈣化醇/ergocalciferol) 透過紫外線照射真菌或酵母而來，效果差。D2效果，不如D3，卻是最常用的處方維生素。
9.添加歐米茄6(例,亞油酸)的補充劑 歐米茄6，易發炎；歐米茄3，抗發炎。
10.廉價的銅 不好的銅，吃太多，堆積在大腦和肝。銅要以正確比例，搭配其他微量礦物質，尤其鋅。

易發炎食物： 1.麩質最糟，來自穀物 2.酒精 3.糖 4.垃圾食物/超加工食品 5.玉米 6.大豆 7.種子油 8.A1牛奶蛋白 9.一般纖維及功能性纖維食品 10.植物性蛋白質產品
發炎患者，甚至豆子、豆科植物和蔬菜，也會導致問題。你可暫改為全肉飲食。
發炎的根本原因始於腸道，稱腸漏症，是腸道滲透率過高。麩醯胺酸是結腸細胞的重要胺基酸，對該情況至關重要。
最佳抗發炎食物是牛肉，其麩醯胺酸含量非常高。麩醯胺酸大大保健腸道，對擺脫發炎有益。
對吃素的人來說，最佳抗發炎食物之一是高麗菜(Cabbage)，尤其紅高麗菜，是麩醯胺酸的重要來源。尤其發酵高麗菜更好，就是酸菜(Sauerkraut)，不但獲得蔬菜的麩醯胺酸，還有微生物。
其他高麩醯胺酸的食物： 1.綿羊或山羊的乳酪、克菲爾 2.蛋 3.魚 4.骨頭湯

柏格醫生 dr berg 談: 高血壓原因，以及高血壓最缺的礦物質。 90%高血壓，是「原發性」高血壓:不明原因引起的高血壓。 降血壓藥是全球最常開的藥之一

人需約1鹽(鈉):2鉀，但很多人吃的太多鹽(鈉)是鉀的3倍
鉀對心血管的作用: 1.控制血管系統收縮，直接影響血壓 2.保健血管內皮層 3.改善胰島素阻抗，使胰島素更正常

鉀的最佳來源: 每天吃至少7-10杯沙拉（一杯子大概200cc大），以獲得所需鉀。 綠葉蔬菜也含鎂，吃鉀和鎂，對降血壓很有幫助。
吃高碳水、糖，會流失鉀，增加腎上腺素、皮質醇時，也流失鉀。
保健血壓，多吃沙拉，增加鉀。也可吃高鉀的優質電解質粉。

ns2:group.ns2:description:
Apple just introduced the brand new MacBook Neo, a $599 Mac that could become one of the most popular laptops Apple has ever released. I’m in New York City at Apple’s Apple Experience event where I got hands-on time with the MacBook Neo along with the other products announced this week.
The MacBook Neo features a completely new design with color options like silver, blush, citrus, and indigo along with a color-matched keyboard. It also becomes the first Mac powered by an iPhone chip, using the A18 Pro from the iPhone 16 Pro lineup.
For $599 you get a 13-inch Liquid Retina display, 500 nits of brightness, Apple Intelligence support, 8GB of RAM, and 256GB of storage. Apple claims it is up to 50% faster than the bestselling PC with Intel Core Ultra 5 and up to 3x faster for AI workloads.
The MacBook Neo also offers up to 16 hours of battery life, USB-C connectivity, Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 6, and a lightweight design that makes it perfect for students and first-time Mac users.
In this video I also briefly recap the rest of Apple’s announcements including the Studio Display XDR with ProMotion, refreshed MacBook Air and iPad Air models, M5 Pro and M5 Max MacBook Pros, and updates to the iPhone 17e.
Preorders for the MacBook Neo are available now and it launches March 11.

ns2:group.ns2:title: The City Behind "Made in China"
ns2:group.ns2:description:
Most people have seen the label “Made in China.”But few people know about the city that helps connect those products to the world.
Yiwu, located in eastern China, is home to the largest small-commodity wholesale market on the planet. Buyers from more than 100 countries and regions come here to source products, negotiate deals, and build international supply chains.
But Yiwu is more than just a marketplace. It’s also a city with centuries of trading history, where ancient streets and modern digital trade centers exist side by side.
From the massive Yiwu International Trade City to the new Global Digital Trade Center, and from historic places like Ximen Old Street and Fotang Ancient Town to creative villages like Lizu Village, Yiwu offers a unique look at how global trade and local culture meet.
Whether you’re interested in global trade, entrepreneurship, or simply exploring a different side of China, Yiwu is a fascinating place to discover.
